# Extract visible user-facing text from index.html labels, buttons, titles, and key JS status strings
python3 << 'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
html = Path('web/index.html').read_text()
# strip style/script
html_clean = re.sub(r'<style[\s\S]*?</style>', '', html, flags=re.I)
html_clean = re.sub(r'<script[\s\S]*?</script>', '', html_clean, flags=re.I)
# get titles
titles = re.findall(r'title="([^"]+)"', html_clean)
aria = re.findall(r'aria-label="([^"]+)"', html_clean)
# get text of buttons/labels/h2/spans that look user facing
texts = re.findall(r'>([^<]{2,80})<', html_clean)
interesting = []
for t in texts:
    t=t.strip()
    if not t or t.startswith('{') or t in ('|','/'): continue
    if any(k in t.lower() for k in ['ε','δ','match','grid','compare','load','upload','select','step','segment','candidate','play','speed','fit','result','score','layer','path','search','kept','point','error','time','budget','dots','squish','back','instruction','status','control','tour','run','orig','file','radius','cell','view','reject','allow','full','this','stream','classic','keep','marker','start','current','choose','preloaded','other','trajectory','simplifier']):
        interesting.append(t)
print('=== VISIBLE TEXTS (filtered) ===')
for t in sorted(set(interesting)):
    print(repr(t))
print('\n=== TITLES with jargon-ish ===')
for t in titles:
    if any(k in t.lower() for k in ['paper','frechet','fréchet','ε','δ','trace','simplify','alive','anchor','thresh','baseline','pts','math','symbol','gi','bbox']):
        print(repr(t))
PY
